description: Direct high-fidelity cinematic video with AI - translates creative intent into technical cinematographic directives, rendered via muapi.ai (Kling).

inputs.name: subject
inputs.description: The subject/action of the shot, e.g. "A lone samurai in a blizzard".

inputs.name: intent
inputs.description: Creative intent - maps to framing/movement/lighting (heroic reveal, tense, introspective, majestic/epic, melancholic).

phases.prompt: Expand subject '{{subject}}' and creative intent '{{intent}}' into a technical shot using the formula: [Shot Type] + [Subject/Action] + [Environment] + [Lighting] + [Camera Movement] + [Lens Effect]. Map intent via: Heroic Reveal -> Low Angle/Wide, Crane Up/Orbit, Rim Lighting/High Contrast; Tense/Uneasy -> Dutch Angle, Handheld Shake, Low Key/Harsh Shadows; Introspective -> Close-Up, Slow Push In, Soft Rembrandt/Window Light; Majestic/Epic -> Extreme Wide, Drone Flyover, Golden Hour/Volumetric; Melancholic -> Profile/Medium, Slow Pull Out, Blue Hour/Desaturated. Use cinematic verbs (Dolly In, Crane Up, Orbit, Truck) and lighting recipes (Volumetric God Rays, Teal-and-Orange Grade, Rembrandt Portrait Lighting). Avoid contradictory movements and complex mid-shot transformations.
